places.name: Fort Worth
places.note: Jake wins at cards in Bill's Saloon and pays to stay with the hard-living Sally Skull, who dies in a jailhouse shootout; he takes her money and leaves.
places.location_hint: Bill's Saloon, a two-story clapboard place on the Trinity River bluffs with a view of passing herds

places.name: Trinity River
places.note: Bill's Saloon stands on its bluffs, overlooking herds trailing north.

places.name: Dallas
places.note: Jake hears the Arkansas sheriff is in Texas, meets the Suggs brothers' regulating and bank-robbing schemes, and rides north with them.

places.name: Montana
places.note: Trail foremen try to hire Jake on learning he has been there.

places.name: Austin
places.note: Jake thinks Lorena could have lived with him in a decent hotel there.

places.name: Georgia
places.note: Sally says she was run out of a town there after a lynching.

places.name: Arkansas
places.note: A soldier reports meeting an Arkansas deputy hunting his sheriff, who hunts a brother's killer.

places.name: Fort Smith
places.note: Jake worries Dallas is too close to it, with July Johnson possibly near.

places.name: Texas
places.note: Jake learns the Arkansas sheriff is somewhere in it.

places.name: Kansas
places.note: The Suggs plan to tax trail herds at its river crossings and rob its banks; Jake means to leave them at a Kansas saloon.

groups.label: Jake and the Suggs brothers
groups.hint: riding north from Dallas toward Kansas, at least a day out
